items.title: CVE-2024-1708 — ConnectWise ScreenConnect
items.summary: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow an attacker to execute remote code or directly impact confidential data and critical systems.

items.title: CVE-2026-32202 — Microsoft Windows
items.summary: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

items.title: CVE-2025-29635 — D-Link DIR-823X
items.summary: D-Link DIR-823X contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to execute arbitrary commands on remote devices by sending a POST request to /goform/set_prohibiting via the corresponding function. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

items.title: CVE-2024-7399 — Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server
items.summary: Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to write arbitrary files as system authority.

items.title: CVE-2024-57728 — SimpleHelp  SimpleHelp
items.summary: SimpleHelp contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows admin users to upload arbitrary files anywhere on the file system by uploading a crafted zip file (i.e. zip slip). This can be exploited to execute arbitrary code on the host in the context of the SimpleHelp server user.

items.title: CVE-2024-57726 — SimpleHelp  SimpleHelp
items.summary: SimpleHelp contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow low-privileged technicians to create API keys with excessive permissions. These API keys can be used to escalate privileges to the server admin role.

items.title: CVE-2026-39987 — Marimo Marimo
items.summary: Marimo contains an pre-authorization remote code execution vulnerability, allowing an unauthenticated attacked to shell access and execute arbitrary system commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-33825 — Microsoft Defender
items.summary: Microsoft Defender contains an insufficient granularity of access control vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to escalate privileges locally.

items.title: CVE-2026-20122 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manger
items.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability due to improper file handling on the API interface of an affected system. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by uploading a malicious file on the local file system. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to overwrite arbitrary files on the affected system and gain vmanage user privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-20133 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
items.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains an exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to view sensitive information on affected systems.

items.title: CVE-2025-2749 — Kentico Kentico Xperience
items.summary: Kentico Xperience contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user's Staging Sync Server to upload arbitrary data to path relative locations.

items.title: CVE-2023-27351 — PaperCut NG/MF
items.summary: PaperCut NG/MF contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations via the SecurityRequestFilter class.

items.title: CVE-2025-48700 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
items.summary: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript within the user's session, potentially leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

items.title: CVE-2026-20128 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
items.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a storing passwords in a recoverable format vulnerability that allows an authenticated, local attacker to gain DCA user privileges by accessing a credential file for the DCA user on the filesystem as a low-privileged user.

items.title: CVE-2025-32975 — Quest KACE Systems Management Appliance (SMA)
items.summary: Quest KACE Systems Management Appliance (SMA) contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow attackers to impersonate legitimate users without valid credentials.

items.title: CVE-2024-27199 — JetBrains TeamCity
items.summary: JetBrains TeamCity contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow limited admin actions to be performed.

items.title: CVE-2026-34197 — Apache ActiveMQ
items.summary: Apache ActiveMQ contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for code injection.

items.title: CVE-2009-0238 — Microsoft Office
items.summary: Microsoft Office Excel contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to take complete control of an affected system if a user opens a specially crafted Excel file that includes a malformed object.

items.title: CVE-2026-32201 — Microsoft SharePoint Server
items.summary: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

items.title: CVE-2012-1854 — Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications (VBA)
items.summary: Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) contains an insecure library loading vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2025-60710 — Microsoft Windows
items.summary: Microsoft Windows contains a link following vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation

items.title: CVE-2023-21529 — Microsoft Exchange Server
items.summary: Microsoft Exchange Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data that allows an authenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2023-36424 — Microsoft Windows
items.summary: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System Driver contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could allow a threat actor for privileges escalation

items.title: CVE-2020-9715 — Adobe Acrobat
items.summary: Adobe Acrobat contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows for code execution

items.title: CVE-2026-21643 — Fortinet FortiClient EMS
items.summary: Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specifically crafted HTTP requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-34621 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
items.summary: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows for arbitrary code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-1340 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
items.summary: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-35616 — Fortinet FortiClient EMS
items.summary: Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-3502 — TrueConf Client
items.summary: TrueConf Client contains a download of code without integrity check vulnerability. An attacker who is able to influence the update delivery path can substitute a tampered update payload. If the payload is executed or installed by the updater, this may result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the updating process or user.

items.title: CVE-2026-5281 — Google Dawn
items.summary: Google Dawn contains an use-after-free vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process to execute arbitrary code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple Chromium-based products including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

items.title: CVE-2026-3055 — Citrix NetScaler
items.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC), NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) and NetScaler ADC FIPS and NDcPP contain an out-of-bounds reads vulnerability when configured as a SAML IDP leading to memory overread.

items.title: CVE-2025-53521 — F5 BIG-IP
items.summary: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow a threat actor to achieve remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-33634 — Aquasecurity Trivy
items.summary: Aquasecurity Trivy contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain access to everything in the CI/CD environment, including all tokens, SSH keys, cloud credentials, database passwords, and any sensitive configuration in memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-33017 — Langflow Langflow
items.summary: Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow building public flows without requiring authentication.

items.title: CVE-2025-32432 — Craft CMS Craft CMS
items.summary: Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

items.title: CVE-2025-54068 — Laravel Livewire
items.summary: Laravel Livewire contain a code injection vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote command execution in specific scenarios.

items.title: CVE-2025-43510 — Apple Multiple Products
items.summary: Apple watchOS, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, and tvOS contain an improper locking vulnerability that could allow a malicious application to cause unexpected changes in memory shared between processes.

items.title: CVE-2025-43520 — Apple Multiple Products
items.summary: Apple watchOS, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, and tvOS contain a classic buffer overflow vulnerability which could allow a malicious application to cause unexpected system termination or write kernel memory.

items.title: CVE-2025-31277 — Apple Multiple Products
items.summary: Apple Safari, iOS, watchOS, visionOS, iPadOS, macOS, and tvOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow the processing of maliciously crafted web content which may lead to memory corruption.

items.title: CVE-2026-20131 — Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC)
items.summary: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the web-based management interface that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary Java code as root on an affected device.

items.title: CVE-2025-66376 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
items.summary: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Classic UI where attackers could abuse Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) @import directives in email HTML.

items.title: CVE-2026-20963 — Microsoft SharePoint
items.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

items.title: CVE-2025-47813 — Wing FTP Server Wing FTP Server
items.summary: Wing FTP Server contains a generation of error message containing sensitive information vulnerability when using a long value in the UID cookie.

items.title: CVE-2026-3910 — Google Chromium V8
items.summary: Google Chromium V8 contains an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

items.title: CVE-2026-3909 — Google Skia
items.summary: Google Skia contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform out of bounds memory access via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability affects Google Chrome and ChromeOS, Android, Flutter, and possibly other products.

items.title: CVE-2025-68613 — n8n n8n
items.summary: n8n contains an improper control of dynamically managed code resources vulnerability in its workflow expression evaluation system that allows for remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2021-22054 — Omnissa Workspace One UEM
items.summary: Omnissa Workspace One UEM formerly known as VMware Workspace One UEM contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with network access to UEM to send their requests without authentication and to gain access to sensitive information.

items.title: CVE-2025-26399 — SolarWinds Web Help Desk
items.summary: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in AjaxProxy that could allow an attacker to run commands on the host machine.

items.title: CVE-2026-1603 — Ivanti  Endpoint Manager (EPM)
items.summary: Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to leak specific stored credential data.

items.title: CVE-2017-7921 — Hikvision Multiple Products
items.summary: Multiple Hikvision products contain an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a malicious user to escalate privileges on the system and gain access to sensitive information.
